stage: every authored action against the parameters its executor reads

result.contract: the executor reads ten action kinds, and the required fields are read with GetProperty, which throws when a field is absent: place needs at; cut needs fov, look, position, seconds and tag; say needs seconds, speaker and text; clip needs clip; move needs speed and stops; face needs target; show needs visible; wait needs seconds; filming needs on; laugh needs level
result.measured: zero parameter gaps: every authored action carries each required field, and NO authored field is one nobody reads. The optional fields (handheld, pushIn on cut; finalFacing on move; talk and deadpan on say) are read through Flag or TryGetProperty and are attributed to those accessors rather than assumed absent
result.why_it_matters: an action missing a required field would break the cutscene in the middle of playing, and a field read by nobody would silently do nothing - the same class as the appearance fields in AI-43
